info.name: BLUE V1 - Checkout
info.description:
BLUE V1 Phase 5 Checkout & Scheduling endpoints, generated from the actual implementation in backend/routes/api.php, backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Checkout, backend/app/Actions/Checkout, and verified against backend/tests/Feature/Checkout. See docs/api-contracts/checkout-v1.md for the full written contract.

Every request requires a valid access_token (run the Authentication collection's Login request first, or set access_token manually) and an ACTIVE cart with at least one item (run the Cart collection's Add Cart Item request first). Payment is explicitly out of scope for this collection - there is no payment/booking request here, only checkout summary, location, appointment availability, and appointment holds.

area_id/property_type_id used in Save Checkout Location must be real, active reference ids seeded in the target environment (see GET /v1/reference-data/registration) - this collection never invents catalog/reference data. appointment_slot_uuid must be a real, active, future appointment_slots row seeded in the target environment; it is not provided by the environment file since it is seed-specific. appointment_hold_uuid is captured automatically from the Create Appointment Hold response's data.checkout.appointment.hold_uuid.

request.description: Returns the customer's ACTIVE cart as a checkout summary - location, current appointment hold, live-repriced items, pricing_status, and ready_for_payment. Never creates a cart as a side effect; with no ACTIVE cart returns a safe empty representation (data.checkout.cart_uuid: null).

body.raw:
{
  "property_type_id": 1,
  "other_property_type_name": null,
  "area_id": {{area_id}},
  "street_name": "Sheikh Zayed Road",
  "address_line": "Marina Tower, near the metro station",
  "building_name_or_number": "Marina Tower",
  "floor_number": "12",
  "unit_number": "1201",
  "nearby_landmark": "Near Dubai Marina Metro Station",
  "additional_location_notes": null,
  "visit_contact_phone": "+971500001234"
}

request.description: Saves the ACTUAL service location for the ACTIVE cart - never the customer's profile address. cart_locations.cart_id is a 1:1 primary key, so this always upserts exactly one row. property_type_id/area_id must be active reference ids. other_property_type_name is required only when property_type_id resolves to the OTHER code. The saved area_id is later mapped to a SERVICE_ZONE through service_zone_areas for pricing - there is no service_zone_id field here, it is never client-supplied. Requires an ACTIVE cart (404 otherwise).

Read-only list of currently bookable appointment slots: active, with an active appointment_time_windows mapping, still in the future, and with remaining capacity (booking_capacity minus every unreleased hold that is either converted or unexpired). Only safe customer-facing fields are returned (uuid, starts_at, ends_at, remaining_capacity, time_window: {code, name}) - internal_note and the internal time_window_id are never exposed. Requires an ACTIVE cart (404 otherwise).

Holds one appointment slot for the ACTIVE cart, preventing another customer from oversubscribing it. Slot identity only is accepted - the backend derives TIME_WINDOW itself from the held slot's appointment_time_windows row (and SERVICE_ZONE from the cart's saved location via service_zone_areas), never from a client-submitted value. Selecting a new slot replaces the cart's previous open hold only after the new slot's capacity is confirmed. 404 for an unknown/inactive slot, a slot whose time window is inactive, or no ACTIVE cart; 422 for a past or fully-booked slot.

Releases the ACTIVE cart's current open appointment hold, if any. There is no hold_uuid parameter - the hold released is always resolved from the caller's own ACTIVE cart, so another customer's hold can never be targeted. A safe no-op (200) when there is no open hold.
